properties.title: Clifton Seaview Modern Villa
properties.description: A statement of waterfront modernism on Clifton's golden stretch. Floor-to-ceiling glazing frames the Arabian Sea while cantilevered terraces deliver uninterrupted sunsets. Imported Italian marble, smart-home automation, and a private infinity pool define this architectural landmark.

properties.title: DHA Phase 8 Sky Penthouse
properties.description: A double-height penthouse crowning DHA Phase 8. The interior is a study in restraint — warm walnut joinery, bronze accents, and a wraparound terrace overlooking the city skyline. Fully furnished with European designer pieces.

properties.title: Bahria Town Premium Mansion
properties.description: A grand Mediterranean-inspired mansion set within a gated enclave. Sweeping driveways, a columned portico, and a dramatic central atrium. The grounds include a formal garden, a heated pool, and staff quarters for six.

properties.title: DHA Phase 6 Contemporary Villa
properties.description: A clean-lined contemporary villa balancing concrete, glass, and warm timber. The ground floor opens fully to a landscaped courtyard with a reflective pool. Award-winning local architecture.

properties.title: Gulberg Heritage Mansion
properties.description: A restored heritage mansion in the heart of Gulberg. Original 1950s proportions meet restrained modern interventions — brass inlay doors, teak staircases, and a private inner courtyard with a fountain.

properties.title: Bahria Orchard Luxury Farmhouse
properties.description: A weekend farmhouse on an acre of manicured land. Vaulted living spaces open to an infinity pool and a private orchard. Designed for entertaining, with an outdoor kitchen and a fire lounge.

properties.title: F-7 Modern Architectural Mansion
properties.description: A landmark of Islamabad's F-7 sector. Brutalist concrete volumes float over glass, anchored by a stone-clad core. The lower level houses a spa, cinema, and a temperature-controlled wine cellar.

properties.title: Bahria Heights Penthouse
properties.description: A penthouse perched above the Margalla foothills. Double-aspect living rooms, a private rooftop garden, and a sky terrace with a heated plunge pool. Sold fully furnished.
